genre.skipped: genre tables already exist; immutable run artifacts are not overwritten

pca.note: PCA(2) is re-fitted on the fitted model's transformed feature space for display. It does not replace the model representation.

profile.skipped: profiles.csv already exists; immutable run artifacts are not overwritten

tsne.note: Visual only: not used to select K, models, or to compute validity metrics.

visual_caveats.location: Post-hoc views are written under artifacts/posthoc/<run_id>/ and do not mutate run artifacts.
visual_caveats.pca2: PCA2D is a display projection, not the default clustering representation.
visual_caveats.sampling: Deterministic bounded samples; underlying coordinates are exported as CSV.
visual_caveats.tsne: t-SNE is visual only; distances, densities and K must not be read from it.
